role: source first-order logical equivalence of formulas
notes: Holds iff every L-structure and assignment satisfy both formulas or neither; metalinguistic, not alpha-equivalence and not string identity; used in sec:fol-cardinality-normalforms-03. Same relation as the editorial \(\varphi\Leftrightarrow\psi\) on first-order formulas; typed apart from \(\mathcal M\equiv\mathcal N\) by its formula operands (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles).

role: source metalinguistic equivalence sign joining lines of a displayed propositional calculation
notes: Asserts logical equivalence of consecutive displayed CPL formulas; a sign of the metalanguage, with the object-language biconditional written \(\leftrightarrow\). Holds iff \(\alpha\leftrightarrow\beta\) is true under every valuation (thm:p01-w02-p01-025-equiv-bridges).

Printed only inside the restoration provenance scopes (environment inheritedrestorationscope), which occur throughout the book; there the macro \texttt{\detokenize{\defeq}} is redefined to print := and the editorial \(\mathrel{:\equiv}\) is restored on exit. The left expression abbreviates the right one; not object-language identity. Same role as the global editorial \(a\mathrel{:\equiv}b\), different glyph.

Least constructor congruence containing \(Qx\,\varphi\equiv_\alpha Qy\,(\varphi[y/x])\) for \(y\notin\operatorname{Var}(\varphi)\); the same relation as the registered \(=_{\alpha}\). Unrelated to the P3 Morley ordinal-indexed back-and-forth relation written \(\equiv_\alpha\) (def:p03-morley-approximants).

role: set of reflexivity and function/relation congruence axioms of a signature
notes: Contains every choice of distinct bound variables, hence every alpha-variant of its members.

role: natural deduction for first-order logic without the rules =I and =E
notes: Same language as ND_FOL; the identity sign is an ordinary binary relation symbol with no rules.

role: application of a finite substitution sequence from left to right
notes: Proof-local notation in the annex; \(\sigma\cdot[s/z]\) extends the sequence.

role: source first-order logical equivalence of formulas in exercise solutions
notes: Same role as the row scoped to the P2 first-order source chapters; used in the solutions for ex:fol-cardinality-normalforms-05 and ex:automated-reasoning-03 to join lines of a displayed chain of first-order formulas (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 1).

role: source alpha-equivalence of first-order formulas in the alpha rule side condition
notes: Same role as the row scoped to sec:fol-syntax-semantics-04; side condition of the bound-variable conversion rule on the rule sheet (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 4).

role: schematic register entry: logical equivalence relative to a declared semantic class
notes: Style rule of sec:latex-style-01 contrasting the metalinguistic relation with the object-language biconditional, and the notation-table entry of app:notation (the chapter preamble before sec:registered-notation-01), available after a semantic class is declared; instances are the CPL row and the first-order rows (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 5). No other use of the glyph lies in the range.

role: schematic register entry: logical equivalence relative to a declared semantic class
notes: Notation-table entry, available after a semantic class is declared; instances are the CPL row and the first-order rows (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 5).

role: number-theoretic congruence of natural numbers modulo n
notes: Holds iff n divides t-a; operands are numbers and the modulus is displayed by \texttt{\detokenize{\pmod}}; used once, in the proof of lem:goedel-beta with moduli 1+(i+1)m; not a formula of the arithmetic object language. Remainder bridge: thm:p01-w02-p01-025-equiv-bridges part 5 (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 6).

role: many-one equivalence of sets of natural numbers
notes: \(A\leq_m B\) and \(B\leq_m A\); same relation as the registered row for \(\equiv_m\), whose scope (P4 frontiers-computability) does not include rem:jump-convention (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles item 7).
